note: This is a pre-registered qualitative application; it does not reinterpret 03E.2 full-agent results. Selecting a future task does not start QLoRA.
rationale: TASK_B is selected under the frozen qualitative policy: its oracle-category root-cause result is meaningfully above the frozen uniform-within-category baseline, remains non-saturated, has 57/57 schema- and enum-valid outputs, and is hardware-feasible. selection_basis: TASK_B meaningful above frozen baseline, non-saturated, clean protocol; TASK_C not preferred because category-stage bottleneck dominates.
selection_policy: 03F frozen qualitative criteria; no post-hoc numerical threshold
